title: Prove paired-Dn COPY floor for two interacting rational shears
body:
PR5176 leaves two changing-split basis shears open after proving the paired-Dn COPY floor for a fixed bipartition. This closes that changed boundary: every product of two rational elementary shears has complete algebraic COPY bill at least the number of live roots, for every paired simple graph and every common directed fitting binary pairing.

The proof exhausts all index collisions, both three-coordinate chain orders and opposite pairs. The latter follow from an arbitrary two-coordinate GL2 lemma, including diagonal-product cancellation. The joint optimum over the family is the coordinate bill; no exact minimum is claimed for each fixed nonzero basis. Original credit remains with ywz65 PR2536/2719, DreamingOfClouds PR3045, Nick Petalas PR5176 and their retained lineage.

Validation covers 2,268 full factorizations, 40,176 common-pairing invoices, 10,044 independent span-rank comparisons, 48 GL2 blocks and 144 additional rational boundary cases. The actual predecessor 12-root D5 graph has all 144 Gram entries checked and complete common-pairing bills 13, 15 and 12 for chain, opposite and cancellation fixtures. Wrong inverse order, false middle-coordinate anchoring, zero-rank implementation, forbidden fitting entries and malformed inputs are challenged.

CPython3.12 normal/optimized commands, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history checks, official export and fresh Git-free normal/optimized replay pass. Missing RESULT/SOURCES, source corruption and an actual nested int-to-float receipt substitution outside the cheap-control target reject. Independent AI proof review includes 50 separate chain matrix controls. These finite checks corroborate the written theorem; they are not independent human or kernel acceptance.

This is an algebraic obstruction, not a physical supplier or exponent change. Three interacting shears, larger basis blocks, single-sign deletions and all physical coefficient/access/restoration/storage/movement costs remain open. Open next questions and complete source attribution are in the package. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI assistance, Apache-2.0.
